faq.howToStart.question: How do I get started?
faq.howToStart.answer: Create a free account, generate an API key, and send your first request through our OpenAI-compatible endpoint in under five minutes.
faq.modelsSupported.question: Which models are supported?
faq.modelsSupported.answer: We aggregate 100+ models from major providers — chat, vision, embeddings and more — behind a single unified API.
faq.billing.question: How does billing work?
faq.billing.answer: Pay-as-you-go with real-time usage tracking. You only pay for the tokens you consume, with no minimum commitment.
faq.routing.question: Can I control how requests are routed?
faq.routing.answer: Yes. Configure load balancing, automatic failover and per-key rate limits across your upstream channels.
faq.security.question: Is my data secure?
faq.security.answer: All traffic is served over HTTPS and we never store your prompts. Enterprise plans add private deployment and audit controls.
faq.selfHost.question: Can I self-host the gateway?
faq.selfHost.answer: Yes. The platform is open source and can be deployed on your own infrastructure with full data ownership.
faq.enterprise.question: Do you offer enterprise plans?
faq.enterprise.answer: Absolutely. Enterprise plans include private deployment, SLA-backed support and dedicated channels for production workloads.
faq.compatibility.question: Is it compatible with the OpenAI SDK?
faq.compatibility.answer: Yes. Any OpenAI-compatible SDK works out of the box — just point the base URL at our gateway and keep your existing code.
